structures_ref.format_notes: POSCAR in Å, extxyz energy in eV (total), report energies in eV/atom

Q_dielectric.reason: atomforge computes structures and energies with an analytic EAM potential; it has no dielectric-loss model, and EAM cannot represent O, N or Si. Do not use this value.

loss_tangent.reason: atomforge computes structures and energies with an analytic EAM potential; it has no dielectric-loss model, and EAM cannot represent O, N or Si. Do not use this value.
loss_tangent.relation: If the uniform-loss model in device.hpp holds, Q_dielectric = 1 / loss_tangent.

junction_gap_ueV.reason: The superconducting gap is not a ground-state total-energy quantity and atomforge does not compute it. Reserved in forge.materials.v0.

atomforge_computed.caveat: Classical EAM results, not DFT. Not a QPU-stack dielectric calculation and not valid as DFT input without verification (see results/NiAl for an EAM failure case).
